entries.title: Infinitary opens when you click it while your crew keeps working
entries.body: After you quit Infinitary's window, your crew keeps working in the background. Clicking Infinitary in the Dock, Spotlight or Finder then opened nothing on a Mac; it now opens the window again. Update and restart also installs the new version and brings the window back, where it used to stay on the old version with no window.
entries.noPicture: The window that opens is the usual one; what changed is that a click and an update now open it.
